newsitem.title: UK: TURK TUPRAS BUYS 50,000-60,000 T GAS OIL-TRADE.
newsitem.headline: TURK TUPRAS BUYS 50,000-60,000 T GAS OIL-TRADE.

text.p: Turkey's state oil refinery Tupras has awarded two cargoes of gas oil totalling between 50,000 and 60,000 tonnes for August delivery through a tender, traders said.
Tupras would pay a premium of around $8 a tonne CFR to Tempotrade for a cargo of between 25,000 and 30,000 tonnes to be delivered to the Gulf of Izmit in late August, the traders said.
Tupras would also pay around the same value to Glencore for another cargo of the same size to go to the Gulf of Izmit by August 20.
The gas oil is of 0.5 percent to 0.7 percent sulphur quality.
The premiums are based on Italy fob Mediterranean published quotations.
